jobs.description:
Focus V makes connected smart devices, including the CARTA 3. We're looking for a software engineer to work across device firmware, our mobile app, and the cloud services that connect them.

* Build and maintain embedded firmware for our devices: Bluetooth LE, Wi-Fi, OTA updates, bootloader, display UI, storage, and heating control.
* Ship features and fixes in our React Native (Expo) mobile app, including device pairing, control, and update flows.
* Develop the Firebase backend: authentication, device provisioning and ownership, security rules, usage data, and rewards.
* Maintain factory tools for flashing, provisioning, and validating devices, and support our manufacturing partner on production issues.
* Diagnose field issues with customer support and beta testers, and ship fixes quickly.
* Contribute to internal web tools used by our operations teams.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years of professional software experience, with shipped embedded or connected-device products.
* Strong C/C++ on microcontrollers (ESP32 or similar): RTOS, UART/SPI/I2C, memory-constrained debugging.
* Hands-on Bluetooth LE experience (GATT, custom protocols) and OTA update design.
* React Native and TypeScript experience; app store release experience.
* Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions, security rules).
* Comfort owning a problem end to end, from device to app to server.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Telink or Espressif SDKs, LVGL, FatFs, or bootloader work.
* Experience with Next.js, Supabase/Postgres, or Vercel.
* Experience with manufacturing test and provisioning.
* Consumer hardware launch experience.

jobs.description:
**About Rivet**  
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems — fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking — for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.  
  
We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.  
  
At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.  
  
**Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).**

**Summary**

As a Software Engineer, Embedded Systems / Firmware, you'll work at the intersection of software and hardware to build and maintain the low-level platform stack that powers Rivet's body-worn and field-deployed devices — including our AR/XR soldier systems, which combine real-time sensor fusion (cameras, IMUs, depth sensors) with a display and compute pipeline running on embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments. You'll focus on the kernel, BSP, HALs, drivers, and board bring-up that make that pipeline reliable, secure, performant, and power-efficient enough to run all day on a warfighter's body.  
  
You'll work closely with hardware, electrical, and sensor-fusion/AR software engineers to integrate new hardware, debug issues across the full system stack, and deliver platform software/firmware that holds up under the SWaP, thermal, and ruggedization constraints of field-deployed defense hardware. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership over meaningful pieces of the platform.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain system-level software/firmware for power- and thermally-constrained, body-worn embedded devices across embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments, with a focus on the kernel, BSP, HALs, and device drivers.
* Bring up new hardware and peripherals, working closely with electrical and hardware engineers to debug issues across the hardware/software boundary.
* Debug complex issues involving hardware, kernel, drivers, boot processes, power management, memory, and system performance — with power and thermal efficiency treated as first-class constraints given our SWaP requirements.
* Develop automated tests for system-level software, including hardware-in-the-loop validation**.**
* Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform bring-up activities.

**Requirements**

* BSin CS/CE/EE, or equivalent industry experience.
* 3+ years of experience developing system-level software/firmware for embedded Linux or RTOS environments.
* Experience developing embedded software/firmware for ARM-based SoCs, MPUs, or MCUs in systems with multiple interconnected processors.
* Experience developing and integrating low-level device drivers, interfacing with custom hardware and peripherals, and bringing up new hardware.
* Strong C/C++ programming skills and familiarity with low-level debugging and development tools such as JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
* Experience with common hardware interfaces and protocols such as USB, MIPI, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet, and PCIe.
* Ability to diagnose complex system-level issues using logs, traces, debuggers, and hardware instrumentation.
* Familiarity with embedded software test automation and hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) or system integration testing
* Comfortable working cross-functionally in a highly collaborative environment with engineers across software, electrical, mechanical, and systems disciplines.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, if required for the role.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MS in CS/CE/EE, or equivalent industry experience.
* Understanding of embedded Linux/RTOS/bare boot processes, device configuration, memory management, and system initialization for embedded Linux, RTOS, and bare metal environments across SoC, MPU, and MCU platforms.
* Working knowledge of trusted boot chain, secure OTA updates, system integrity, and other platform security mechanisms.
* Experience with Yocto, Buildroot, Bazel, Soong, or similar embedded/system build environments.
* Experience developing embedded software/firmware for resource-constrained, body-worn, or wearable devices with power, thermal, memory, or compute limitations.
* Experience working on safety-critical, high-assurance, defense, aerospace, or other demanding embedded systems.
* Experience with camera, display, or sensor pipelines feeding AR/XR or spatial-computing applications.
* Active security clearance.

Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO.
